verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents natural-language creation and editing of agents/automations ('describe what you want in chat', 'summarise my unread emails' → drafted agent, 'only reply to paying customers' rewriting instructions) plus a built-in MCP server enabling AI assistants to build flows and manage the platform via natural language. This is corroborated by dedicated MCP docs and product pages, though independent hands-on verification of the NL-to-agent flow is absent. missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of natural-language agent creation working reliably in practice, and detail on limits/edge cases of NL command coverage.
